verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered-agent service lists LegalZoom's address as the registered agent on public records instead of the founder's, explicitly for privacy. LegalZoom also updates the registered-agent information with the Secretary of State, so the provider address appears on the state filing. Missing for 10: evidence that the provider address can be used beyond the registered-agent field (e.g., principal office or mailing address on formation and annual-report filings), state-by-state limits on where it is permitted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
